releases.notes:
The 2.1.0 release of NotEnoughUpdates.

Download: https://github.com/Moulberry/NotEnoughUpdates/releases/download/2.1.0/NotEnoughUpdates-2.1.jar

This update was brought to you by various contributors, namely:
Nopo, DeDiamondPro, CraftyOldMiner, Nea89, Lulonaut, CrypticPlasma, Hannibal, Efefury, Jani, DoKM, Walker, Cobble8, 2stinkysocks, IRONM00N and Asyncx

Main features:
- Added an armor overlay for the new armor slots
- Price graph for items on /ah and /bz
- Wishing compass solver
- Added /hex command
In addition to lots of miscellaneous improvements and bug fixes

Full update notes: https://github.com/Moulberry/NotEnoughUpdates/blob/master/Update%20Notes/2.1.md

The 2.0.0 release of NotEnoughUpdates.

Watch HellCastle & FurryEBoy's video to learn about NEU's most important features: https://youtu.be/RtTDU2Zfk0w

Download: https://github.com/Moulberry/NotEnoughUpdates/releases/download/2.0.0/NotEnoughUpdates-2.0.0.jar

This may be the last NEU update made by me (Moulberry).
If you would like to learn why, head over to #announcements on https://discord.gg/moulberry

- If you are updating from 1.7, this version of NEU is going to be a treat. This is the prerelease, which usually lives in #neu-prereleases at https://discord.gg/moulberry. If you haven't joined, you definitely should - future updates to the prerelease will be there, not here. However, due to the [recent changes](https://hypixel.net/threads/update-to-disallowed-modifications-qol-modifications.4043482/) I am releasing an updated version here. This release should be compliant with the new hypixel rules.

If you are updating from 1.7.3, read #neu-prereleases on the discord to learn about all the cool new stuff, there is waaaaaay to much for me to be able to list it all here.

Download: https://github.com/Moulberry/NotEnoughUpdates/releases/download/2.0-PRE26/NotEnoughUpdates-2.0-PRE26.jar

- Dungeon profit checker now shows: current lowest bin, average lowest bin (one day) and average auction
(If you have a texture pack that changes how the dungeon profit background looks, they will need to update)
- Dungeon profit checker now gives more helpful output when it can't find the price for an item
- Event timer in inventory now renders behind tooltips (still don't know why anyone plays on GUI scale auto but ok)
- Notification during spooky event when it hits 7am (can be disabled)
- New config option to disable NEU click sound effects
- Click sound effect no longer played when clicking background glass panes
- (Hopefully) fixed dungeon map missing players
- Dungeon map now has option to change icon size (room indicators & players)
- Dungeon map icon style now has option to use a black border

Download: https://github.com/Moulberry/NotEnoughUpdates/releases/download/1.7.1-REL/NotEnoughUpdates-1.7.2-REL.jar
Patreon: https://patreon.com/moulberry
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPh-OKmRSS3IQi9p6YppLcw
Twitch: https://twitch.tv/moulberry2
Discord: https://discord.gg/spr6ESn

New features
- Added /neucalendar - view all skyblock events, favourite them, etc.
- Added event timer in inventory (shows which crops are upcoming in jacobs farming contest as well)
- Added notification when a skyblock event starts
- Add notification 5m before a skyblock event starts (time can be changed in /neusettings)
- Can filter event timer & starting notification using neucalendar, including filtering specific crops in jacobs farming contest
- Sneak-right-click to trade now works on other players' islands
- Auction/items now show the average lowest bin price (over the last 3 days) instead of the current lowest bin. To see the current lowest bin, activate "advanced price info"

NOTE: In order to show crop types for the farming event, you need to have seen actual event inside hypixel's calendar at least once

New config options
- Show event timer in inventory
- Show event notification
- Event notification before time

Changes
- Dungeon profit in lore now won't show "item is rare" as often
- Dungeon profit in lore now uses the average lowest bin over the last 3 days for more accurate pricing
- Dungeon map now rotates more smoothly
- Dungeon map now has sliders for map size & room size
- Fixed dungeon map crashing caused by Hypixel adding too many players to the map (now a cap of 6)
- Backpack preview in /pv & trade window now work with latest sba beta
- Fixed NEU capes bugging when going past 50k blocks out
- Grouped items in the itempane are now ordered properly
